SELECT k.id, k.title, k.summary, k.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, k.status, k.updated_at AS updatedAt
, AS score
, AS score
, 0 AS score
FROM knowledge_item k LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = k.category_id
AND ( MATCH(k.title) AGAINST (#{kw} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) OR MATCH(k.summary) AGAINST (#{kw} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) OR MATCH(k.content) AGAINST (#{kw} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) )
AND ( k.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') OR k.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') OR k.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') )
AND k.category_id IN #{cid}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item_tag it WHERE it.item_id = k.id AND it.tag_id = #{tagId})
AND k.content_type = #{contentType}
AND k.status = #{status}
AND k.updated_at >= #{from}
AND k.updated_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND (k.status = 'PUBLISHED' OR k.author_id = #{visibleAuthorId})
AND k.status = 'PUBLISHED'
ORDER BY k.updated_at DESC, k.id DESC
ORDER BY k.view_count DESC, k.id DESC
